fact_text: The founder said the first Sizzlerz outlet in Gulshan, opened in 2014, was budgeted at about 10 to 12 million (local currency) in investment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder said the first Sizzlerz outlet in Gulshan ended up costing about 14 to 15 million (local currency), above its budget of 10 to 12 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder said the group opened its second outlet about six months after the first, and a Chinese chops brand about six months after that, expanding in quick succession.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder said the Defence outlet was planned about six years before it finally opened, and he expected it to take about six months to mature into a steady business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: Sizzlerz serves beef steaks of 230 to 240 grams, a portion the founder said is sized so that a diner leaves satisfied, and that rivals serving smaller portions face quality questions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: Sizzlerz uses three Karachi suppliers for its premium cut, and the founder said that when volumes strain supply, suppliers and restaurants can compromise on meat quality.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: A dish priced around 600 PKR earlier was repriced to about 900 PKR, which the founder said passed purchasing cost increases on to customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder said rising salaries, rent and overall spending squeezed margins, and that utility costs could not be fought, so menu price rises were only partly absorbable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: Restaurants and hospitality are among Pakistan's largest sources of permanent employment, after construction, which mostly employs daily wage labour, according to a sector skills council study.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: A Karachi Chamber of Commerce calculation put restaurant sector growth at about 26 percent before the COVID period.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder argued that dine-in restaurants sell an experience of service that home delivery cannot copy, so online delivery was not seen as replacing fine dining.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder said the Chai The Sky concept uses a rooftop setup suited to Karachi's weather to cut electricity consumption, and passes the saving to customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: The founder said a restaurant investor must understand the kitchen and service in depth, since putting money behind a trusted chef without that knowledge gives fair odds of losing it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: Outlets need 90 to 100 pieces a day, and the founder said no ordinary supplier can meet that volume.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sizzlerz Founder Tells Us How He Turned His Passion Project Into a Business Success | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-12)

fact_text: Weekend demand is 150 pieces a day across the outlets, rising to nearly 200 pieces, according to the founder.

fact_text: Weekend demand can reach nearly 200 pieces a day, the founder said.
